description: Use Vessica's CLI-backed setup and engineering workflows, with optional remote MCP when configured during installation.

interface.shortDescription: Work with Vessica through its version-matched CLI and optional remote MCP.
interface.longDescription: Use the version-matched ves Go CLI for workspace setup, engineering runs, harnesses, previews, recovery, and operator workflows. A concrete OAuth-protected remote MCP connection is added only when VES_MCP_PUBLIC_URL is configured during installation.
